description: Allows to post events to Datadog (www.datadoghq.com) service.

parameters.name: aggregation_key
parameters.description: An arbitrary string to use for aggregation.

parameters.name: date_happened
parameters.description: POSIX timestamp of the event. Default value is now.

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: Host name to associate with the event. If not specified, it defaults to the remote system’s hostname.

parameters.name: priority
parameters.description: The priority of the event. Choices: "normal" ← (default) "low"

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Comma separated list of tags to apply to the event.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: If false, SSL certificates are not validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Post an event with low priority
  community.general.datadog_event:
    title: Testing from ansible
    text: Test
    priority: low
    api_key: 9775a026f1ca7d1c6c5af9d94d9595a4
    app_key: j4JyCYfefWHhgFgiZUqRm63AXHNZQyPGBfJtAzmN

- name: Post an event with several tags
  community.general.datadog_event:
    title: Testing from ansible
    text: Test
    api_key: 9775a026f1ca7d1c6c5af9d94d9595a4
    app_key: j4JyCYfefWHhgFgiZUqRm63AXHNZQyPGBfJtAzmN
    tags: 'aa,bb,#host:{{ inventory_hostname }}'

- name: Post an event with several tags to another endpoint
  community.general.datadog_event:
    title: Testing from ansible
    text: Test
    api_key: 9775a026f1ca7d1c6c5af9d94d9595a4
    app_key: j4JyCYfefWHhgFgiZUqRm63AXHNZQyPGBfJtAzmN
    api_host: 'https://example.datadoghq.eu'
    tags:
      - aa
      - b
      - '#host:{{ inventory_hostname }}'
